# Sydney Automation Co.

> Accredited Clipsal C-Bus and Signify Dynalite specialist in Sydney. Same-day emergency repairs, programming, fault finding, and system design for lighting control automation across residential, commercial, and strata properties. Based in Menai, servicing all of Greater Sydney.

## Who We Are

Sydney Automation Co. is founded and operated by George Skarmoutsos — a former Clipsal National Technical Support specialist with 15+ years of hands-on experience in lighting control automation. George holds the following manufacturer accreditations:
- **Schneider Electric / Clipsal Accredited C-Bus Programmer** — programming, commissioning, and fault finding using C-Bus Toolkit software
- **Signify / Philips Dynalite Accredited System Designer** — programming and design using Dynalite System Builder software
- **DALI / DALI-2 Lighting Control** — diagnostics, commissioning, and AFSS emergency lighting compliance testing
- **RAPIX Emergency Lighting** — programming and compliance for RAPIX emergency lighting systems

Every service engagement includes a 100% database backup handover of your system programming to the client.

## Core Services

- **C-Bus Fault Finding & Repair** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/cbus-fault-finding-sydney): C-Bus network voltage check (15–36V DC), network burden verification, module-level diagnostics, and C-Bus Toolkit software scanning for Clipsal C-Bus systems
- **C-Bus Programming** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/c-bus-programmer-sydney): New system commissioning, scene programming, scheduling, logic engine scripting, and multi-room integration using C-Bus Toolkit
- **C-Bus Upgrades** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/cbus-upgrade-sydney): Modernisation of legacy C-Bus 5000-series hardware, adding mobile app control (C-Bus Home Control), touchscreens, and PIR/daylight sensors
- **Dynalite Fault Finding** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/dynalite-fault-finding-sydney-common-faults): DyNet communication bus diagnostics, address conflict resolution, processor resets, and network topology verification
- **Dynalite Programming** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/dynalite-programmer-sydney): System design and commissioning using Dynalite System Builder software for commercial and residential installations
- **DALI / DALI-2 Lighting Control** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/dali-lighting-control-system-sydney): DALI bus commissioning, emergency lighting AFSS compliance testing, and DALI-2 integration with BMS systems
- **Emergency Repair** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/emergency-repair-sydney): Rapid-response same-day emergency service for total lighting control system failures across C-Bus, Dynalite, DALI, and RAPIX
- **RAPIX Emergency Lighting** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/services): Programming, testing, and compliance verification for RAPIX emergency lighting systems in commercial buildings
- **AFSS Emergency Lighting Compliance** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/afss-emergency-lighting-services): Annual fire safety statement emergency lighting testing, log book maintenance, and compliance documentation
- **Strata & Facility Management** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/strata): Tailored lighting control support for managed buildings, strata committees, and facility managers including compliance documentation and system handover
- **Electrician Partnership** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/electricians): Specialist backup for licensed electricians who encounter complex C-Bus, Dynalite, or DALI automation faults beyond their scope

## Technical Protocols & Systems

Sydney Automation Co. works with the following lighting control protocols and systems:
- **Clipsal C-Bus (C-Bus 2)** — Proprietary RS-232 lighting control protocol by Schneider Electric/Clipsal. Operating voltage: 15–36V DC. Key software: C-Bus Toolkit. Hardware includes 5500PC network interface, 5500PS power supply, 5000-series dimmers/relays, L55-series modules, Saturn/Neo/Element keypads, C-Bus touchscreen interfaces
- **Signify Dynalite** — DyNet protocol (RS-485) based system by Signify (formerly Philips). Operating voltage: up to 16V DC, data lines 0–3V on data+ and data-. Key software: Dynalite System Builder. Hardware includes DDBC1200 processors, DDMC802 dimmer controllers, DDNG232/485 network gateways, Antumbra keypads, DUS360 occupancy sensors
- **DALI / DALI-2** — Digital Addressable Lighting Interface standard (IEC 62386). Used for emergency lighting compliance (AFSS), commercial building lighting, and integration with BMS. Brands: Tridonic, Philips, Osram, Meanwell
- **RAPIX** — Emergency lighting control system by Signify. Used in commercial and institutional buildings for mandatory emergency lighting circuits
- **Apple HomeKit Integration** — C-Bus to HomeKit bridge solutions for voice control via Siri and Apple Home app

## Technical Library

We maintain a library of 500+ model-specific troubleshooting guides at https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/tech-library covering:
- LED status indicator codes for all C-Bus and Dynalite hardware
- Buzzing, clicking, and audible noise diagnostics
- Frozen or unresponsive interface troubleshooting
- Schedule and timeclock drift repair
- Surge and storm damage assessment
- Network communication faults and bus crashes

## Diagnostic Capabilities

George carries specialist diagnostic equipment including:
- Multimeter for C-Bus voltage checks (15–36V DC) and DyNet RS-485 bus testing (up to 16V, data lines 0–3V)
- C-Bus Toolkit and Dynalite System Builder software on-site laptop
- DALI bus analyser for DALI-2 emergency lighting compliance
- Network analyser for Ethernet-based C-Bus/EIB communication faults
- Infrared thermal camera for identifying overheating modules and loose connections
